race.comment: The Broome Cup for 2026 and KINGS SICARIO (12) ticks plenty of boxes on the back of a dominant Kimberley Cup win. He picked them up and ran away with the win there and the extra distance won't be an issue. Rates highly off that and drops in weight. Can bring up the hat-trick. PHAROAH SHOW (7) jumped an odds-on chance in the Kimberley Cup but was no match for KINGS SICARIO. The SP is worth noting though and he won very impressively two back with a strong rating. Meets KINGS SICARIO better at the weights and with a touch of luck from the draw, he can go one better. ICHIBAN (6) goes from 1600m to 2200m today, though he has won 2/4 at this trip. Brings some strong Darwin form across with Jarrod Todd on board. Can feature on his recent form. MANAVENDRA (2) bolted in to score the Port Hedland Cup and Galati sticks with him over KINGS SICARIO. Can repeat the dose. ZADAR ROCK (1) comes through the Port hedland Cup where he jumped favourite. Keep safe.
